notes: Exploring a deserted world to piece together a story is Adventure, and the intake answers keep it to one small ruined town with countryside around it, explored in whatever order the player likes — world-open, one continuous surface, so no chapter split. Exploration is the preset; I added collectible-nodes for the notes, recordings and objects the answers name as how the story is told, and settlement-density so the town reads as a town against the empty countryside rather than scattered houses. With no user to ask I assumed no enterable interiors — nothing in the prompt or the answers says the player goes inside, so the ruins are explored from the outside and the build stays on P0. Realism is a rendering instruction rather than a layout one, so it changed nothing here.
